description:
Responsibilities: 
 

 * Design, implement and test requirements 
 * Ensure compliance to all requirements and maintain accuracy for same and design all technical system documents and architectural standards. 
 * Recommend enhancements to designs and prepare software for reuse. 
 * Resolve emergency production issues and ensure appropriate resolution of all issues within required time-frame. 
 * Document designs and perform unit tests and develop appropriate applications. 
 * Design code for system design and prepare efficient application programming interfaces. 
 * Collaborate and build relationships with analysts, project managers, other development teams, operate and operations partners, and clients. 
 * Provide implementation support 
 * Identify opportunities to fine-tune and optimize the application 
 

 * Minimum 5 years of experience in designing and developing Java/J2EE enterprise applications in medium to large scale IT Projects. 
 * Experience of working on developing Unit Test Plan, associated Unit Test Case and Unit Test results 
 * Experience in working with multiple file formats (XML, text, CSV etc.), large data sets, code debugging and debug defects 
 * Experience in design and development of Dashboard applications, web based applications and real time integration 
 * Ability to convert business requirements into specifications and be able to analyze, design, develop and integrate applications. 
 * Strong technical skills, dedication, innovation, drive for excellence. 
 * Strong communication skills and able to work effectively in a team environment. 
 * Must have strong knowledge in Object oriented development, version control, release management, change management. 
 * Demonstrates exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
 


  HTTP, J2EE, Java, JDBC, jQuery, JSP, Management, Programming, Project, Release, Security, Test Plan,
